_note: Read by .github/scripts/release.py. Git Warden is one umbrella release with one version for all guard posts: a single component, tag vX.Y.Z. A new binary is added as another build command and asset of this component, not as a component of its own. paths: only commits touching them count. build/assets: {name} and {ver} are replaced. The binary should expose the version via -X main.version.

components.name: git-warden
components.notes:
### Install

Download `push-guard-linux-amd64` below (`chmod +x`), or build from source as described in the README. The binary doesn't install anything: the wall host also needs `git` and `gitleaks` (see Requirements in the README). The Pull Guard is a git-everref run and has no binary here. `LICENSE` and `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` are attached for the license notices.
